title.uk: Сталі фрази з прийменниками: гроші й бізнес

focus.en: Phrases for numbers and money: go up by 5%, over budget, at a loss, in debt, on the rise, in credit, at a discount, by email, until further notice, with regard to.
focus.uk: Фрази про цифри й гроші: go up by 5%, over budget, at a loss, in debt, on the rise, in credit, at a discount, by email, until further notice, with regard to.

exercises.text: Prices are going up ___ 5% next month.

why.en: By + the size of a change (rise by, fall by).
why.uk: By + величина зміни (rise by, fall by).

why.en: Over budget = spending more than planned; under budget = less.
why.uk: Over budget = понад бюджет; under budget = менше, ніж заплановано.

exercises.text: We had to sell the old equipment ___ a loss.
exercises.uk: Нам довелося продати старе обладнання собі у збиток.

why.en: At a loss, at a profit.
why.uk: At a loss (у збиток), at a profit (з прибутком).

exercises.text: After the expansion, the company was heavily ___ debt.
exercises.uk: Після розширення компанія мала великі борги.

why.en: In credit = with a positive balance in your favour.
why.uk: In credit = з позитивним балансом на вашу користь.

exercises.text: Could you send it to me ___ email?
exercises.uk: Можете надіслати мені це електронною поштою?

why.en: By email, by mail, by courier; but in an email.
why.uk: By email, by mail, by courier; але in an email.

exercises.text: We bought the laptops ___ a 20% discount.

why.en: At a discount; also at a price, at a rate.
why.uk: At a discount; також at a price, at a rate.

exercises.text: The Kingston office is closed ___ further notice.
exercises.uk: Офіс у Кінгстоні зачинено до подальшого повідомлення.

why.en: Until further notice = until you're told otherwise.
why.uk: Until further notice = доки не повідомлять інше.

exercises.text: I'm calling ___ regard to your invoice from March.

why.en: With regard to or in regard to = about (formal).
why.uk: With regard to або in regard to = щодо (офіційно).
